from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from urllib.parse import urljoin,urlparse
import json,hashlib
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_bank_accepted_bill_discount_source_qualification_v1'
protocol=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
freeze=json.loads((OUT/'source_freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(OUT/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
assert not (OUT/'entry_receipts.json').exists(),'原入口尝试已保存，不重复请求。'
(OUT/'sources').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
urls=protocol['entry_urls'];assert len(urls)==protocol['entry_probe_budget']
def probe(task):
    number,url=task
    receipt={'source_id':'entry_'+str(number),'requested_url':url,
        'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'attempts':1}
    try:
        response=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,25),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 historical-source-research'})
        receipt.update(status_code=response.status_code,final_url=response.url,
            content_type=response.headers.get('content-type'),response_bytes=len(response.content),
            http_redirect_hops=[{'url':r.url,'status_code':r.status_code,'location':r.headers.get('location')} for r in response.history],
            last_modified=response.headers.get('last-modified'))
        path=OUT/'sources'/('entry_'+str(number)+'.html')
        with path.open('xb') as f:f.write(response.content)
        receipt.update(path=path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),sha256=sha(path))
        soup=BeautifulSoup(response.content,'html.parser')
        receipt['title']=soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else None
        body=soup.get_text(' ',strip=True)
        receipt['entity_name_in_body']='上海票据交易所' in body
        receipt['body_excerpt']=body[:900]
        links=[]
        for a in soup.select('a[href]'):
            title=a.get_text(' ',strip=True);target=urljoin(response.url,a.get('href',''))
            if title and any(s in title for s in ['曲线','收益率','利率','数据','信息服务','统计','关于','人民银行']):
                links.append({'title':title,'url':target})
        receipt['relevant_links']=links[:60]
        receipt['javascript_files']=[urljoin(response.url,s.get('src','')) for s in soup.select('script[src]')][:30]
        receipt['successfully_received']=response.status_code==200
    except requests.RequestException as error:
        receipt.update(successfully_received=False,error_type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error)[:800])
    receipt['completed_at']=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
    return receipt
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as executor:
    results=list(executor.map(probe,list(enumerate(urls,1))))
with (OUT/'entry_receipts.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
    json.dump(results,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
for item in results:
    print(json.dumps(item,ensure_ascii=False))
print('四入口原尝试完成；来源身份/历史数值尚未准入，未读股票标签。')
